purpose: prove each unit of logic behaves correctly in isolation and keep that proof fast and trustworthy
entry_criteria: Code under test builds locally and in CI
Unit boundaries and seams for isolating dependencies exist
Test framework is chosen by the repository
procedure: List behaviors per unit, including boundaries, invalid input and error paths.
Write tests that isolate external dependencies with fakes or stubs, one behavior per test, with descriptive names.
Run tests and confirm each new test fails when the behavior is broken (mutate the code or revert the fix).
Remove time, randomness and ordering dependence so tests are deterministic.
Run the whole unit suite in CI and record counts, duration and coverage change.
Report skipped or quarantined tests with owner and reason.
acceptance_criteria: Every new behavior has a test that fails without the change
Suite is deterministic across three consecutive runs
No test depends on network, clock or ordering
Skipped tests are listed with owners
validation_method: Rerun in CI and compare with the local run.

validation.command: pytest -q --maxfail=1 --cov --cov-report=term-missing   # example for Python; use the project's runner
validation.expect: exit 0; failed 0; coverage not below baseline

validation.command: for i in 1 2 3; do pytest -q -p no:randomly || break; done
validation.expect: three green runs in a row

failure_modes.detection: Mutating the code leaves tests green
failure_modes.response: Strengthen assertions; mark stage FAIL until mutation is caught
Fix or quarantine with owner and expiry; do not retry-until-green

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A price-rounding function gets tests for exact cents, half-up cases, negative amounts and zero. Reverting the rounding fix makes two tests fail, which proves they check behavior.
